title: CoreDirective Agent Registry
description: Schema for .agents/registry.yaml. Every LLM-calling agent in the CoreDirective stack appears as one row. Enforced by inventory_scan.py and registry-validate CI job. See .agents/README.md for tier semantics and the row-add workflow.

agent_id.description: Lowercase snake_case unique identifier. Locked to RFC-1123 subset so it is safe as a Datadog tag value. Cardinality budget for this key is approximately 20.

runtime_location.description: Free-form path or canonical service URL where the agent actually runs. Use canonical hostnames like droplet:openclaw-gateway rather than real IPs so the registry is public-shareable.

owner.description: GitHub handle or email of the human accountable for the agent.

sensitivity_tier.description: Blast-radius classification. See .agents/README.md for tier definitions.

capabilities.description: Concrete capability tokens in snake_case with optional colon-scoped suffix. Action-verb prefixes preferred (read_, write_, invoke_, post_).

data_access.description: What data classes the agent can read or write. Use stable identifiers (paths with glob, named scopes, channel handles) rather than free prose.

auth_method.description: Enumerated authentication path. Adding a new value requires a schema bump plus a row in .agents/README.md auth method vocabulary.

last_audited.description: ISO date of last manual audit of this row (YYYY-MM-DD).

is_ai_agent.description: True for LLM-callers (Agent Card required in Plan 20-02). False for pure tooling identities; the schema still lets them appear so inventory_scan can diff against them.
